name: canine-command-center
description: AI-first companion app for raising a dog — breed-aware training curriculum across months/years, health & vet, diet, grooming, socialization, exercise, enrichment, and 'Scout', an in-app Claude expert. Monorepo: Expo mobile + Vite/React web + Fastify/Postgres API + shared TypeScript core.

pnpm.comment: Pin react + react-dom to one exact version monorepo-wide — they must match exactly at runtime, and an optional react-dom peer (via @expo/metro-runtime) otherwise floats to a newer patch than react.
